title: cryptogramma gracilis
intro: Cryptogramma gracilis, commonly known as the Rockfoil or Western Rockfoil, is a type of flowering plant in the family Saxifragaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cryptogramma gracilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing.
